title: Public Safety
description: A mod about the devils and contracts in the anime Chainsaw man
body:
The Public Safety mod focuses on adding the devils from chainsaw man into minecraft, including their powers.

This mod includes 7 Devils as of now

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
![Fox Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fed3320913b98f37071b2df7829a6779b803e70f.png)  
-Fox Devil (Contract is in structures)
  
  ![Shark Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4115da652f9c54d1a5823da3b05d30c85beb4efe.png)
  -Shark Devil
  
![Zombie Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92160f834f1165eda2f160470476669edc88cf36.png)
-Zombie Devil

![Fish Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0770cf85f9bc1468077d044299c1b20700a16a19.png)
-Fish Devil

![Tomato Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08495e17ce5e54a927eac1a4bbe4a3b5e453a212.png)
-Tomato Devil

![Gun Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfc12df5fd965f83e27d4b04f2172b269cf29ceb.png)
-Gun Devil (Must collect gun devil pieces from other devils to craft the contract)

![Curse Devil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be8cd80d22c663afc34055a9df6d2ae140c1c121.png)
-Curse Devil (Contract is in structures)
</details>
Each devil has features and abillities you can use and experience with this mod.
